recommended_approach: Mantaflow GAS Multi-Flow Domain with Dissolve Smoke for a steady campfire (separate flame/smoke flows, fire enabled, noise enabled)

key_parameters.Surface Emission: resolution-dependent; keep controlled for a compact campfire source

warnings: If Noise is enabled but no noise simulation data exists, the domain can appear empty.
The domain must have a material assigned for rendering.
Surface Emission depends on domain resolution; overshooting it can broaden the fire source.
Campfire smoke can accumulate and fill the whole domain; the pattern library specifically flags this, so dissolve smoke is important.
API doc grounding for bpy.types.FluidDomainSettings was weak in the search bundle; verify exact RNA names in the current Blender build when scripting.
alternative_approaches: Basic single-emitter Mantaflow GAS fire/smoke setup.
Single-flow Mantaflow GAS fire augmented with Wind/Turbulence force fields via bpy.ops.object.effector_add for added motion.
